provenance.method: Retained interval analytical method of steps; signed-v49 reconstruction. Display conversion only.

provenance.interpolation: Linear interpolation of interval midpoints for animation only; not a certified continuous trajectory. Before the first retained endpoint, only release and the window-end bounds are available.
limitations: Shared stored-rate, inclusion and arithmetic premises remain those of the scientific review.
The late return-path review lacks its own negative-source-speed known control; its acceptance there retains that inferred-correctness limitation.
Not all early endpoint records retain partner-class diagnostics; missing values are not reconstructed.
provenance.time: Physical T = 10t. Animation uses each uncertain endpoint’s lower time bound; diagnostics retain the full interval.
provenance.units: w = signed speed in wake-speed units; a, radial and support in cf²/R; physical acceleration/support divide by 10; support rate divides by 100.
